social.text: Actor isolation 🎬 Actor isolation is using framing and staging to visually separate one character from everyone else. Tools: a clean single with no one else in frame, a wide shot with empty space around them, a different level or orientation from the group, or a tighter focus. Isolation works even in a crowd.
